### Main questions

We want to find the mutation statistics for Ben's samples

- Set paths

```{r}
setwd("/camp/lab/luscomben/home/users/palk/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis/")
```

### 2.0 Include experiment matrix

- Let's first include the reactivity gene expression matrix and the supplied experiment matrix.

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

experiment_matrix_df <- data.table::fread("01-alignment/input_files/nfcore_sampleinfo.csv", data.table = F)
experiment_matrix_df$ERAP <- str_split(experiment_matrix_df$sample, pattern = "_", simplify = T)[,2]
experiment_matrix_df$replicate <- str_split(experiment_matrix_df$sample, pattern = "_", simplify = T)[,1]
experiment_matrix_df <- experiment_matrix_df[,-c(2,3,4)]
experiment_matrix_df$condition <- ifelse(experiment_matrix_df$replicate %in% c("C2", "C6"), "ctrl", "vcp")

experiment_matrix_df$fraction <- "whole"

```

### 3.0 Make mutation statistics table

```{r}

file_list <- list.files("04-locating-mutations-in-the-cell-line/output_files/")

mut_stats_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(experiment_matrix_df)), function(x){
    current_file <- grepl(x = file_list, pattern = experiment_matrix_df[x,"sample"])
    current_df <- read.table(file.path("04-locating-mutations-in-the-cell-line/output_files/", file_list[current_file]), header = F)
    colnames(current_df) <- c("chr", "start", "ref", "alt", "ref_freq", "alt_freq", "fwd_read", "rev_read")
    cbind(experiment_matrix_df[x,], current_df)
}))

mut_stats_df$percent_ref <- mut_stats_df$ref_freq / (mut_stats_df$ref_freq+mut_stats_df$alt_freq)



```
